# Step - import_graphml

`import_graphml` · category: [Graph information and files](../../traversal/step_reference.md#graph-information-and-files)

Imports a GraphML file into the graph as one unit (needs file access).

## Forms

```text
import_graphml(arg1: string)
```

## Example

```rhai
g.import_graphml("modern.graphml")
```
